title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.13900v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that execute long-horizon tasks through reasoning, tool use, code generation, and workspace manipulation. As agents increasingly operate over persistent environments and multi-step workflows, they face challenges analogous to those addressed by transactional database systems: reliable execution, consistent outcomes, safe concurrency, and durable state management. We introduce the concept of an agentic transaction and propose an ACID-compliant agent system framework that reinterprets the classical ACID properties for agent execution through four semantic guarantees: Semantic Atomicity, Semantic Consistency, Semantic Isolation, and Semantic Durability. translated_title: 代理事务：迈向符合ACID标准的代理系统
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.13900v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）代理正从对话助手演变为通过推理、工具使用、代码生成和工作区操作执行长周期任务的自主系统。随着代理越来越多地在持久环境和多步骤工作流中运行，它们面临与事务数据库系统所解决的问题类似：可靠执行、一致结果、安全并发和持久状态管理。我们引入了代理事务的概念，并提出了一个符合ACID标准的代理系统框架，通过四种语义保证重新诠释了经典ACID属性在代理执行中的应用：语义原子性、语义一致性、语义隔离性和语义持久性。这些属性共同为在模型不确定性和动态执行环境下构建可靠代理系统提供了原则性基础。为了实例化该框架，
tldr: 本文提出了一个ACID兼容的代理系统框架，通过重新定义原子性、一致性、隔离性和持久性为语义属性，以应对LLM代理在复杂任务中的可靠性和一致性挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an ACID-compliant agent system framework that redefines atomicity, consistency, isolation, and durability as semantic properties to address reliability and consistency challenges in LLM agents handling complex tasks.
